section_summary.evidence_source: "The current sample of Black women reported higher average BAS scores than the development sample (comprising primarily White college students; Avalos et al., 2005), t(545) = 6.75, p < .001."; "The current sample also endorsed lower average scores on the EDE-Q-R, t(949) = 4.53, p < .001, and the EDE-Q-EC, t(949) = 3.15, p = .002... Average scores on the EDE-Q-SC, t(947) = 2.09, p = .037, and the EDE-Q-WC, t(947) = .80, p = .422, did not differ significantly between the two samples."
